historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; extracts the rendered data offset without proving usable capacity or consistency with the header/area layout.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds bounds and no-log-mutation controls but lowers capability for pending layout/reboot inputs.

original_test_intent: Verify the Type 15 Log Data Start Offset marks the approved beginning of event records, leaves the intended header region, lies within Log Area Length, yields the expected usable data capacity and remains stable after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete raw/decoded Type 15 records, preserve data/header offsets and area length with access/status/format context, compute bounds, header-region size and data capacity against the platform layout, then repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves the data-layout/capacity baseline and reboot plan. Clearing or populating the log is unnecessary and excluded.
required_inputs: Expected raw/decoded Log Data Start Offset
Expected Log Header Start Offset and Log Area Length
Expected usable event-data capacity and access-method implementation
Validated parser plus approved reboot/OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Snapshot existing logs read-only; do not clear, write or inject events.
Preserve raw numeric values and verify Data Start Offset is within area and properly ordered/aligned relative to the approved header layout.
Compute data capacity from the approved field semantics rather than treating offset alone as sufficient.
Do not infer that event data is readable or that BMC SEL uses the same storage solely from this offset.
Stop on zero/overlap/out-of-range contrary to policy, drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete Type 15 layout, validate data-start bounds/alignment and derived capacity, and compare pre/post reboot.
Do not mutate logs, access undocumented storage or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the data-start/header/area and alignment/capacity policy.
Approve reboot/recovery, resolve implementation-specific zero/alignment cases and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The field selector is relevant, but the fragment omits raw value, header/area relationships, alignment and derived usable capacity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 15 records and calculate data-start bound, header-region relationship, alignment and usable capacity from the approved layout.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Log Data Start Offset scope, Type 15 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; generic log clearing is excluded.

modernized_recommendation.status: DATA REGION BOUND AND CAPACITY VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Validate raw data offset jointly with area length and header offset/format, calculate the usable event-data region and compare all layout invariants across reboot without changing log contents.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 15 System Event Log implementations.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, event-log implementation and parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 15 data offset and event-log layout semantics, approved platform design and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw bounds, alignment and derived-capacity analysis to the isolated decoded field.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; detects a correct-looking offset that creates an undersized, overlapping or out-of-bounds data region.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Full area/header/data layout and capacity policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Metadata layout validation does not prove actual records can be decoded or retained; those are separate read/access tests.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a different data offset/capacity for a firmware release, but must version area length, header offset/format and alignment together; event-log growth is not a reason to change the metadata expectation.
expected_evidence: Approved platform/firmware identity and complete Type 15 data-layout/capacity policy
Complete pre-reboot Type 15 record with raw/decoded data/header offsets, area length, access/status/format
Bound, ordering, alignment, header-region and usable-capacity calculations
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot metadata diff without clearing logs

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The data-offset field has clear layout semantics; unsafe generic clearing is a nonessential step excluded by locked policy.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Offset and capacity calculations are safely automatable; missing platform layout is readiness only.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw bounds, alignment, header-region and data-capacity evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains no-mutation/layout safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates project layout/reboot inputs and formal engineer verdict from capability.

review_improvement: Prevents an in-range-looking number from passing when it overlaps the header, violates alignment or leaves the wrong usable log capacity.
independent_technical_reasoning: Data start, header start and area length are structured numeric fields; their approved layout invariants and persistence are deterministic software checks.
